corrections.old_text: ቀለም ፡ ነው ፡ ፊላ ፡ መፍቀሪ ፡ ታዎ ፡ ስመ ፡
corrections.corrected_text: ቀለም ፡ ነው ፡ ፊላ ፡ መፍቀሬ ፡ ታዎ ፡ ስመ ፡
corrections.reason: Both the printed glyph (which has the 5th-order loop at the bottom of ሬ rather than the 3rd-order top-left serif of ሪ) and Classical Ge'ez morphology require the 5th-order agentive noun መፍቀሬ ('lover of').
The printed text clearly shows the 6th-order ሳድስ glyph ል in ቃል ፡ ሥግው ('the Incarnate Word', noun + adjective), not the construct ቃለ.
